walls.name: Do not port WebAC's render/lighting stack
walls.rule: WebAC's fixed-function Gouraud/gamma lighting, SceneryInstancePool, OverlayMergePool, fixed-light-count padding and RendererWarmup solve problems holtburger already solved better (BatchedMesh statics, 16+2 light pool, asyncLink, composer-variant warm). No stack change (TS/Vite/vitest) is merited.

walls.name: WebAC WeenieErrorText.ts is not a source
walls.rule: It is ACE <summary> text plus invented overrides. Build failure text only from acclient.c HandleFailureEvent (done: gen_retail_failure_table.py).

walls.name: Hex-Rays atan2 operand swap
walls.rule: set_vector_heading, get_heading, Vector3::get_heading and SmartBox::GetObjectBoundingBox print swapped atan2 args. Port as atan2(y,x), as ACE AFrame.cs does.

walls.name: Scenery noise constant
walls.rule: Retail uses 2^-32 (confirmed from exe bytes), not ACE's double literal 2.3283064e-10.

walls.name: ACE Entity/Scenery.Load is dead code
walls.rule: Never use it (or the gate1 C# probe built on it) as a scenery oracle. Live ACE physics uses Landblock.get_land_scenes, which matches retail CLandBlock::get_land_scenes.

walls.name: deg_mul is pinned at 1.0
walls.rule: Retail CalcDegLevel holds deg_mul=1.0 above ~15 fps (30-entry history blocks <0.01 steps). RETAIL_DEG_MUL=1 is the faithful constant; the 'deg_mul auto-tune' lead (PERF-LOG :276) is closed.

walls.name: SurfaceTexture two-level lists are not animations
walls.rule: They are HiFi+normal detail levels (ImgTex::GetSurfaceDID); exactly one is drawn. Audit: 0 two-distinct-resident pairs, so nothing cycles.

walls.name: CObjCell::IsInView returns 1
walls.rule: Only CLandCell overrides it (in_view). Retail never cell-gates interior particles through IsInView; RP6 freezing off-frustum interior emitters is non-retail.

walls.name: No retail LoginRequest resend against ACE
walls.rule: Retail's 2 s LoginRequest resend causes BadHandshake or a self-boot on vanilla ACE. Resend only ConnectResponse. The bridge Disconnect must go to the login port.

walls.name: Plugin bus handlers must read .detail
walls.rule: The bus delivers CustomEvent{detail}. Reading fields off the Event is a recurring bug (buffs-hud, salvage, carnage/blood, rynth webhost); lint-event-consumers DETAIL_KNOWN_BUGS tracks it.

walls.name: three.js material/shadow traps
walls.rule: Material.copy/clone drops onBeforeCompile but keeps userData (program-key mismatch, patches lost). The shadow pass ignores opacity. THREE.LOD measures unscaled distance from its own position. Flipping transparent does not bump version (OPAQUE define sticks).

walls.name: Program ledger must match by program id
walls.rule: ShaderMaterial cacheKeys start with WebGLShaderStage ids that are re-minted after dispose, so hashing the full key misses relinks. three replaces info.programs on context restore, so track array identity, not length.

walls.name: Release wasm size no longer means dev
walls.rule: Release builds are ~7.2-7.6 MB, so a size threshold (6 MB) flags them as dev. Detect dev from the name/.debug_* custom sections. The MEMORY '~4.5MB=release' figure is stale.

walls.name: metaf is culture-invariant
walls.rule: There are no comma-decimal .nav/.met files (0 in the corpus); only .utl thresholds via VTClassic HaxConvertDouble. Keep parseFloat leniency in core rynth nav_file.js.

walls.name: Rynth parity invariants
walls.rule: tests/rynth_vt_parity.test.mjs (T-P1) and the buff GOLDEN digest must stay identical; never edit existing rynth tests without owner sign-off.

walls.name: Eval-harness test constraint
walls.rule: projectile_ballistic_arc/projectile_spin tests eval method bodies with a fixed set of identifiers. Add logic behind this._helper?.() or typeof guards, never as new module-level consts in those methods.

walls.name: Native-testable placement
walls.rule: The wasm crate's session module is wasm32-only, so pure logic (chat formatters, inventory tracker) goes in src/*.rs outside session (e.g. src/chat_format.rs) to be unit-testable.

walls.name: Hash function trap
walls.rule: holtburger-dat utils::string_hash is not retail compute_str_hash; spellbase_string_hash is the match.

walls.name: Audio retail facts
walls.rule: interface_sound_volume is a dead retail pref (no Interface slider). Retail ambient-off freezes the queue (holtburger's fast-forward is better). The retail row pick is floor((N-1)*roll); WebAC's floor(N*roll) is wrong.

walls.rule: maps-chargen-barber-5 (all four towns already offered); MA-6/8/9/10/11; 'gender key not in gear table' (0 cases); OrigPaletteId vs texture palette precedence (0 of 2,983 differ); claimed missile overshoot = speed x latency (it is jitter-scale).

walls.rule: Portal-storm events and AdminEnvirons are dev/admin-only on vanilla ACE. Armor highlight bit 0x100 is never sent (Nether tint invisible). ACE refuses corpse access with transient strings plus a plain UseDone.

walls.rule: Chromium flips :focus-visible on the first keydown, so a :focus-visible guard does not stop mouse-focused controls from eating Space/Enter. Use releaseMouseFocus (ui/hud_focus.js).

walls.name: OpenAC is a reference, not truth
walls.rule: Do not copy OpenAC where it diverges from acclient.c: GetAdjustedMaxSpeed (drops x4.0 / speed-factor divide), inverted sledding branch, 4 m body-snap + 0.6 s stale-velocity heuristic, client walk-to-object before Use, SalvageItemPolicy 0xFF000000 (retail = Retained bit), radar UI-hidden 0x80000000 (retail 0x80) and spawn-time radar flags, lerp/slerp frame sampling (HB discrete sampling matches retail).
walls.ref: 4-remote-motion.md D2 + 'already matches'; FINDINGS-round1 physobj/csequence/use summaries; round2 radar; round3 crafting

walls.name: Wire SetState is verbatim
walls.rule: CPhysicsObj::set_state assigns state verbatim; set_ethereal + overlap defer only via EtherealHook. Keep USE_ETHEREAL_RECHECK=false; ACE does door-hold overlap server-side.

walls.name: FindObjCollisions passability
walls.rule: Skip only when ETHEREAL AND IGNORE_COLLISIONS; ETHEREAL alone passes (obstruction_ethereal); IGNORE_COLLISIONS alone still blocks.

walls.name: Native DXT upload premise false
walls.rule: DAT DXT surfaces have no mip chain (second level is same size); WebGL can't mip compressed textures, and wasm decode feeds normal/height planes. Don't re-propose s3tc base tier; finish texCompressedOnly instead.

walls.name: Draw-count cuts do not predict ms
walls.rule: Resident != drawn != submitted; 37.6 us fixed/draw with r²=0.014 vs instances (cost is state validation). Frame is CPU-bound (8.2x pixel sweep moved p50 25.8->26.3 ms). T8/T10 most likely to under-deliver.

walls.name: OpenAC absolute ms don't transfer
walls.rule: OpenAC frame is ~4-7 ms C#; holtburger ~20-25 ms dominated by three.js per-draw overhead (12.78 ms draw funnel). Only relative structure (what stops being O(instances)) carries over.

walls.name: Vulkan-only techniques
walls.rule: Bindless, MDI indirect + SSBO transforms, BaseVertex global arena, AOT SPIR-V, mmap pak + OS threads are not available in WebGL2; substitutes already in place (array textures, BatchedMesh multi_draw, prewarm).

walls.name: statBatchRuns adds nothing over memo slots
walls.rule: With statBatchMemoSlots=4 default, cell runs gave ~no further walk-CPU gain and one 1070 rep read worse; don't re-flip without GPU data.

walls.name: Pools' culling-off trade
walls.rule: SPEC pools' perObjectFrustumCulled=false costs +420k tris/frame (+81%) on buckets and would invert on weaker hardware.

walls.name: drawSortProgram was dead until 10-06
walls.rule: punchRetail's setOpaqueSort overwrote the program sort on every default boot; any A/B before 10-06 measured nothing. Punch phase is now the primary comparator key.

walls.name: 1070 measurement traps
walls.rule: Display sleep drops Chrome rAF to 1 Hz (~1008 ms frames); off-screen-window WebGL screenshots are black; frames snap to 8.33 ms vsync steps; one rep is not a verdict; __drawSort.probe once counted render() calls (~38/frame) as frames.

walls.name: SetHoldKey Run arm
walls.rule: Decomp shows the None->Run upgrade arm can't fire; motioninterp-6 skipped.

walls.name: Portal tunnel busy
walls.rule: Retail m_cBusy only drives the cursor; SetCombatMode is the one gameplay reader of teleportInProgress. Do not drop uses/casts/drags in the tunnel (ACE answers YoureTooBusy).

walls.rule: update_internal fires frames [old,new) clamped to segment end; advance_to_next_animation fires none. 1,498 of 2,214 last-frame hooks were double-fired before; 716 never fire in retail.

walls.name: Post-await liveness = identity
walls.rule: After any await, check `inst._disposed || entityMap.get(guid) !== inst` (_isLiveInstance); entityMap.has(guid) passes on a same-guid respawn. Negative-control tests must fail for the .has form.

walls.name: Never capture renderer.properties/capabilities/info/shadowMap
walls.rule: three initGLContext replaces them on context restore; read live or re-bind on webglcontextrestored. Same WebGL2 context object survives restore, so f.gl!==gl can't detect it.

walls.name: Failure is not absence
walls.rule: Distinguish fetch failure from proven absence at the wasm boundary; never cache a failure without TTL (30 s re-ask pattern).

walls.name: Re-check generation/residency after every await in bake/attach
walls.rule: Evict/park can land mid-await; check a generation/epoch, guard finally blocks against newer builds.

walls.name: Plugins mount before login with client:null
walls.rule: Subscribe via window.__pluginClientReady; tests must mount with {client:null} and no global (production order).

walls.name: ?v= specifiers duplicate module instances
walls.rule: Importing one module under two specifiers evaluates it twice; dev page and esbuild bundle then differ.

walls.name: Flag polarity footgun
walls.rule: Readers coded !== 'off' are ON when absent; trust the reader, not comments/url-flags.md.

walls.name: frameTime clock freezes under renderOnDemand
walls.rule: Wall-time throttles must use a live monotonic clock (5 sites already fixed).

walls.name: No live textures in Material.userData
walls.rule: three r184 Material.copy JSON-serializes userData; use WeakMap side channel / non-enumerable (388x-2758x clone cost).

walls.name: GC does not reclaim GPU
walls.rule: three.js resources need explicit dispose(); exactly one dispose per resource (ownership rule).

walls.name: wasm-bindgen free() not idempotent
walls.rule: Copy-then-free in finally; ?.free?.() does not guard double free.

walls.name: SW cache-first only for content-addressed URLs
walls.rule: boot.hba and manifest/<ns>.bin change bytes under same URL; gate on bake identity, no memo TTL.

walls.name: wasm32 integer wrap is silent
walls.rule: usize is 32-bit and overflow-checks=false in all profiles: use checked_add/checked_mul, safe_capacity.

walls.name: freezeStaticMatrix must freeze subtree
walls.rule: three r184 still walks/recomposes descendants of a frozen container; set matrixAutoUpdate/matrixWorldAutoUpdate on subtree, exclude animated props.

walls.name: Particles depthWrite:false vs depth-based post
walls.rule: Haze/AP passes read terrain depth behind particles; draw particles after haze. On split frames a late draw tests wrong depth, so don't.

walls.name: RG16F max 65504
walls.rule: Half-float target sentinels must be finite (<=6e4).

walls.name: Ortho camera writes linear depth
walls.rule: three writes log depth only for perspective; passes decoding log depth must retarget/skip on camera switch.

walls.name: pmndrs EffectPass sorts by attribute
walls.rule: Effect order is attribute-descending, not declaration order (SSAO NONE runs after AP). Pass.mainCamera no-op on custom passes.

walls.name: owner_registry _epochs must not be pruned
walls.rule: Timer-deferred creates read owner epoch; pruning tried and reverted.

walls.name: Refuted: RUSTNET-2, SHELL-6, camDebug sessionHandle
walls.rule: Bridge reaps 90 s silent sessions; char-select relogin unreachable; camera.js has a sessionHandle getter. Do not re-raise.

walls.name: perPolyCull regresses on real GPU
walls.rule: R9 290 regression, reverted 2026-07-06; negFace front copy depends on it.

walls.name: Settled-off flags
walls.rule: castRangeWarn eye test failed; swamp failed; USE_ETHEREAL_RECHECK wrong path; particleClock=sim freeze is a bug; castCamBias broken; sortCenter defect; entityLights doubles lights.

walls.name: reversedZ June 'no-win' was CPU-bound
walls.rule: Don't cite it as a GPU result; 1070 perf A/B (?reversedZ=off) still owed.

walls.name: shadows checkbox removed, not rewired

walls.name: Wind clips closed loop

walls.name: Indoor spawn collision before init3D

walls.name: Fixtures must use real ObjCellIDs

walls.name: 120 Hz rAF quantization
walls.rule: The 1070 panel is 120 Hz: frame times sit on an 8.33 ms grid, a saving that does not cross a grid line reads +0 fps. Compare means and lows, not p50; use hbbench --uncapped for continuous fps.

walls.name: renderer.info hides BatchedMesh sub-draws
walls.rule: three r184 counts a BatchedMesh multidraw as ONE call; ANGLE D3D11 emulates it per range (full draw + gl_DrawID + vertex UBO upload). Use __diag.render.subDraws/issuedSubDraws, not calls.

walls.name: Main-thread-only A/Bs cannot see CrGpuMain cost
walls.rule: The July walkInInstance A/B that 'refuted the draw-count model' measured renderCPU only; CrGpuMain (WebGL decode + DOM raster) was 79% busy and is invisible to CPU profiles. Measure with gpu_thread_split.py.

walls.name: June 'log depth is a no-win' does not apply
walls.rule: That A/B ran at 22 fps CPU-bound with the GPU at idle clocks; today's towns at ultra are fill-bound. Log depth writes gl_FragDepth and kills early-Z.

walls.name: GPU timer queries around CPU-bound passes
walls.rule: Timer queries around a CPU-bound pass report the submit span (world pass 18.1 ms 'GPU' vs 19.1 ms CPU), not GPU work.

walls.name: gpu.service/decoder tracing inflates GPU process
walls.rule: disabled-by-default-gpu.service/decoder categories inflate GPU-process cost ~10x (~4 fps traced vs 35-42); use gpu.angle,gpu,toplevel for attribution.

walls.name: Fog probe is not the backlog
walls.rule: farFogSkyHz=0.1 cut long Finish waits 12->1 but worst frames unchanged: the probe is only WHERE the main thread absorbs the GPU-process backlog.

walls.name: Texture pre-upload does not fix first-turn hitch
walls.rule: Pre-uploading 750 textures (122.8 MB) left fps/worst frames unchanged; the hitch was D3DCompile of unrolled light loops.

walls.name: statArrayMerge = 0.0 ms
walls.rule: Measured on the 1070 2026-08-06: -23 draws/frame, frame unchanged. Do not re-derive static bucket-merge arithmetic.

walls.name: Never Object.create materials / vary property order
walls.rule: Prototype-derived or shape-varying three.js materials/nodes make V8 material reads megamorphic for EVERY draw (2.2x slower). Use shape-identical clones.

walls.name: asyncLink skips swapped materials
walls.rule: Any material/program swap experiment is SKIPPED while it links; set window.__asyncLink.off = true or a 'fix' is just a missing draw.

walls.name: readPixels zeros after async readback
walls.rule: three r184 readRenderTargetPixelsAsync left PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER bound; check gl.getError() after readPixels before believing a black frame.

walls.name: D3D folds isnan()
walls.rule: isnan() is folded away by the ANGLE/D3D compile; use exponent-bit tests. NORMAL blend mix(dst,src,1) re-NaNs scrubbed pixels (NaN*0).

walls.name: Program key bits from geometry
walls.rule: Compiling/prewarming over placeholder geometry yields a different program key (vertexNormals bit 23; PMREM needs real attributes) and a second sync link at first real draw.

walls.name: cloneUniforms texture trap
walls.rule: three r184 cloneUniforms gives each texture uniform a NEW Texture on the SAME Source; in-place dispose+respec then reuses immutable storage (GL errors). Share live texture objects; value-copied light arrays freeze too.

walls.name: Fresh profile per arm
walls.rule: Shader/program cache warms the second arm; fresh --user-data-dir per arm and per boot on the 1070.

walls.name: Half-res arm diagnosis
walls.rule: At Linvak Tukal a half-res arm cut GPU 24->18 ms with no fps change: main thread was the limit there (pre staticAnchorFreeze); check GPU vs main-thread bound before GPU work.

walls.name: Cold interior fetch is round-trip structure, not bytes
walls.rule: Academy record fetch limited by dependency-walk bursts on Chrome's 6 HTTP/1.1 connections; capping render at 10 fps saved only ~2-3 s. Fewer, bigger responses is the lever.

walls.name: No effect: interiorStabChunk/walkPace, bakeUrgentReserve=all
walls.rule: Measured within noise on the 1070; do not re-propose as fetch accelerators.

walls.name: scheduler.yield() reorders ahead of fetch deliveries
walls.rule: Interior build yields use MessageChannel posts deliberately; scheduler.yield continuations jump ahead of the fetch deliveries and worker replies the build yields for.

walls.name: SwiftShader cannot judge GPU claims
walls.rule: Laptop headless = SwiftShader: 3D-texture sampling returns 0 (no cloud march), no real GPU timing; GPU look/perf claims need the 1070.

walls.name: 1070 is a person's PC
walls.rule: Check presence (idle + desktop Chrome) before every boot; if someone is on it stop, kill only D:\Temp\hbbench Chrome. Owner: 'if someone is using it then dont continue'.

walls.name: Shadow probes under mover scope
walls.rule: With shadowMoverScope, managed lights run autoUpdate=false; a probe that forces a raster must set light.shadow.needsUpdate per cascade or use ?shadowMoverScope=off.

walls.name: Bright/dark clouds is not boot-order
walls.rule: The per-session sky split is a lost storm look at composer hand-over, not cloudsBootOrder; forcing legacy-first would make stormy DayGroups never look stormy.

walls.name: Frame is CPU-bound
walls.rule: 8.2x fewer pixels changed p50 25.8->26.3 ms. Overdraw/POM/atmosphere/fill/log-depth early-Z/MSAA-cost theories are dead unless boundedness is re-measured after a big change.

walls.name: Scale discipline: resident != drawn != submitted
walls.rule: Every figure must state its scale. Four ~2x errors in one day came from counting resident buckets and pricing them as drawn (_projDrawn ignores frustum).

walls.name: Draws removed x µs/draw does not predict wins
walls.rule: Removable draws are the cheap ones: skipDeadAlpha -12.1% draws = -2.8% frame; walkInInstance -63% draws = -10.5% CPU; statArrayMerge -23 draws = 0.0 ms.

walls.name: Statics bucket merging is DONE AND DEAD
walls.rule: statArrayMerge 0.0 ms, regionDiv sweep 0.00 ms, material-value keying fuses depth-bias clones, canonical tiers cost fidelity. Reopen only on a NEW mechanism; never re-derive bucket arithmetic.

walls.name: Draw funnel is fixed-per-draw; rebuild is per-instance
walls.rule: renderBufferDirect 37.6 µs fixed/bucket, r²=0.014 vs instances; BatchedMesh rebuild 5.9 µs/bucket + 0.348 µs/instance (80% per-instance). Program selection/uniform refresh live inside the funnel.

walls.name: Framework per-object overhead is negligible
walls.rule: three per-object glue 70.7 ns (0.033 ms/frame); customProgramCacheKey 0.003 ms; setupLights <0.02 ms. Light-pool count is load-bearing (count change = relink of every lit material).

walls.name: Traversal: matrix freeze ceiling 0.48 ms
walls.rule: matrixWorldAutoUpdate=false does not prune subtrees in r184; compose is 111 of 340 ns/node. Only node-count reduction attacks traversal; truly inert Groups are a few hundred (~0.2 ms).

walls.name: Per-instance tests still walk the instance
walls.rule: Distance/LOD/size caps only cut submitted ranges (0.038 µs/inst), not the walk (0.348). Splitting buckets spatially adds draws (+196 draws = +8.8 ms).

walls.name: perObjectFrustumCulled must stay on
walls.rule: Turning it off saves 0.40 ms for +81% triangles.

walls.name: Atlas is the weaker merger on volume
walls.rule: Routing all statics through the atlas = 22,365 singletons / 4,576 draws / 89 ms (atlas copies geometry per node). Ring-wide merging (v1 statBatchCrossLb) measured 22.5 vs 29 fps - forfeits node culling.

walls.name: Parked wins can be moving losses
walls.rule: statBatchMemo exact: -2.3 ms parked, +0.5 ms moving. Camera-spin moving tests self-noise (6.6 ms control spread); use a fixed @teleloc path / fixed-pose bench.

walls.name: A/B hygiene
walls.rule: Interleave arms within one session; boot-to-boot differs 40% in bucket count/400 MB heap. Never reuse a Chrome process across arms (2.44x drift); fresh --user-data-dir per arm; settle draws/frame first; pin ?renderScale&adaptiveRes=off&quality.

walls.name: Flag bits are not predicates
walls.rule: ClipMap+Translucent (0x14) must stay transparent; the 77-material opaque arm blanketed the frame and passed every metric. Widening to particles is +1.5 ms and p95 32->50.6. Structural render changes need eye-tests; pixel-diff on an animated scene is not a test.

walls.name: renderer.info counting traps
walls.rule: render.calls undercounts BatchedMesh multidraw (3.94x); autoReset zeroes per render call; ~19 render() calls per rAF; info.render.frame is per call. BatchedMesh position.count is allocated, not used.

walls.name: Remacri did not slow the mean frame
walls.rule: Its costs are wire (81 vs 20 MB terrain), heap, VRAM (context losses) and tail transcodes - not mean frame time.

walls.name: Do not release texture CPU copies broadly
walls.rule: Context-loss restore re-uploads from image.data (7 losses/session on 1070); atlas re-reads img.data/planes/BC7 mips; clones share source; r184 hook is per-source onUpdate (no Texture.onUpload). Only via texFreeCpu + rehydrate seam.

walls.name: OOM is not a disposal leak
walls.rule: Orphaned textures 164 MB non-ratcheting; orphaned geometry 28 MB ('702 MB leaked geometry' was wrong); decodeAdmission high-water theory dead; shard cache converges ~307 MB. Heap is live textures.

walls.name: shardBudgetMB=24 thrashes
walls.rule: ~280 MB evicted-and-refetched churn; size to the working set, never small.

walls.name: Bake worker does no compressed-texture work
walls.rule: bake_worker.js import graph has no bc7/xu7 symbol; every XUBC7 transcode runs on the window thread.

walls.name: Shader prewarm targeting
walls.rule: three keys programs on render target bound at compile time; warm against the composer HalfFloat target. A login-screen catalog warms zero-light variants (rig attaches later). renderer.compile never covers shadow depth materials.

walls.name: Shadow quick-win bans
walls.rule: shadowMaxStale is inert while moving (gated on !shadowDirty); castShadow toggling churns numDirectionalShadows -> full recompile (banned). 1070 boots mid: no CSM/shadow maps at default.

walls.name: Statics cull structure
walls.rule: Per-LB bucketed cull fails (96% nodes cross-LB); outdoor cull is 0.17 ms so outdoor residency caps have no ROI; JS-only missing-surface cache can't reach the worker wasm.

walls.name: Interior bake timing is wire-visible
walls.rule: fetch_env_cells_in_landblock is the sole producer of cell AABBs/membership; changing it changes when landblock_id flips and what ACE spawns. Don't fold EnvCell bake into _guardedStreamBake; draw policy is free to change.

walls.name: Indoor/outdoor retail facts
walls.rule: Render split is cellId<0x100, not SeenOutside; retail uses no clip planes (portal cull + Z-clear + depth stamp + painter order); EnvCells carry per-cell transforms; dungeons escape the 192 box; classify dungeons by numBuildings==0; CEnvCell::UnPack field names are decompiler artifacts.

walls.name: Wind sway vs instancing
walls.rule: windSwayGpu already survives BatchedMesh (USE_BATCHING hash from batchingMatrix); the atlas gate is about material substitution. animated_scenery is NOT a sway template (one shared CPU pose per DID).

walls.name: Global atlas pools are mandatory
walls.rule: Region-scoped arrays cost 1,440 MB vs 142 MB global; sub-rect packing bleeds at mips; ptLayerFull ceiling not binding (0 spills, 74 of 1388).

walls.name: Release wasm only
walls.rule: pkg wasm ~18 MB = dev (~4x tax); release 4.5-6.2 MB. Verify size before any measurement. Never run release builds alongside a live session (earlyoom killed MariaDB).

walls.name: Measurement readiness traps
walls.rule: __bootState ready fires before streaming (wait terrainBakedLbs plateau); liveScene3d is an init snapshot; geometries accumulate over a session (fresh boots); lint-url-flags exit code is always 1 (read the message).

walls.name: Resident != drawn != submitted
walls.rule: Every figure states its scale (@scale tags); four ~2x scale errors happened in one day.

walls.name: draws x us/draw does not predict wins
walls.rule: Never price a frame win from draws removed (statArrayMerge -23 draws = 0.0 ms, DEAD); draw count is a poor proxy (-12.1% draws = -2.8% frame).

walls.name: Parked wins can be moving losses
walls.rule: Moving numbers only from the fixed-pose moving-bench (PC-3); statBatchMemo parked -4.00 ms is not a moving claim.

walls.name: three per-object glue 70.7 ns
walls.rule: Framework-overhead theories are dead; costs live at instance scale and per-draw state validation (37.6 us fixed/draw, r2=0.014 vs instances).

walls.name: Matrix freeze ceiling 0.48 ms
walls.rule: Only node-count reduction attacks the ~3.6 ms traversal.

walls.name: Frame is CPU-bound
walls.rule: GPU-side theories die on a CPU-bound frame (renderScale 8.2x moved p50 25.8->26.3 ms); re-check boundedness after any big change before GPU work. Remacri's mean-frame cost was stalls, not GPU.

walls.name: Allocated != used
walls.rule: Publish both; atlas 1,941 vs 112 layers; BatchedMesh position.count is phantom; never GL texture counts as liveness.

walls.name: Boot variance / Chrome reuse
walls.rule: <0.4 ms unresolvable; 0.4-1.5 ms in-session ABAB; >=1.5 ms interleaved boot arms; fresh Chrome + fresh user-data-dir per arm (2.44x drift); cross-boot single shots valid for nothing.

walls.name: Flag bit != predicate; pixel diffs inadmissible
walls.rule: Structural render changes need owner eye-test; same-arm pixel noise floor 16.9% vs 20.1% across arms; ClipMap failure invisible to every metric.

walls.name: renderer.info autoReset trap
walls.rule: Set autoReset=false, read cumulative, divide by frames, restore.

walls.name: Reject, never average; census after forced GC
walls.rule: Benches emit USABLE/REJECT; first-contact census over-counts.

walls.name: Release wasm + bare default
walls.rule: Targets bind only on --release wasm and bare-default URL; release pkg is ~6.4-6.7 MB now (not 4.5 MB); dev ~18 MB keeps name section.

walls.name: Settle gates
walls.rule: Sample only after draws/frame stable; boot polls accept ready OR in-world via __bootStateHistory; streaming via terrainBakedLbs plateau, never pose.landblockId.

walls.name: Flag-default footgun
walls.rule: !== 'off' readers are ON when absent; never trust a default from a comment or doc — read the *Enabled() reader. New opt-ins use === 'on'.

walls.name: A default-OFF flag can cost the default path
walls.rule: Check what a gate's ALLOCATION costs (composer stencil -> packed DepthStencil blacked out distant views, luma 2.3 vs 62).

walls.name: pass.enabled=false is not isolation
walls.rule: atmosphere_pipeline re-derives pass enables every frame; such isolations are inconclusive.

walls.name: Sky pin fails silently
walls.rule: Gate A/B on '[skytime] pinned' actually appearing; setSkyTimeOverride is persistent one-shot.

walls.name: Vacuous context-loss gates
walls.rule: restoreFailed 0 means nothing unless restores === freed; __restoreContext must use the WEBGL_lose_context handle captured BEFORE loss.

walls.name: Test doubles kinder than the browser
walls.rule: Worker double that drops transfer list / controller double minting fresh buffers hid a detached-buffer bug; make doubles faithful.

walls.name: A test that re-derives truth proves nothing about shipped code
walls.rule: Call the shipped wasm/JS, not a parallel derivation (WS11 vs lib.rs single-anim belief for a month).

walls.name: Controller latch is load-bearing
walls.rule: Do not generalize forget() into delete-on-settle; latch gives D-03.4 dedupe and late second readers.

walls.name: Stale pkg/ reads absent silently
walls.rule: typeof-guarded riders (moveTelemetryDrain etc.) read undefined on old wasm; precheck exports before trusting telemetry; rebuild after Rust pulls.

walls.name: TCP connect != ACE reachable
walls.rule: Confirm reachability by __bootState==='ready' or own account in ACE_Log, never a bare wsbridge socket probe.

walls.name: Screenshots of GL
walls.rule: page.screenshot() photographs a black world; capture via readPixels inside the final present pass. Off-screen 1070 Chrome needs the 3 occlusion/backgrounding flags.

walls.name: T4/other-GPU benches
walls.rule: Bench verdicts from T4/R9 290 are not comparable to the 1070 baseline; route-pin arms (server-side position persists — first unrouted pair invalid).

walls.name: Shared-tree git
walls.rule: git stash/checkout --/restore/reset --hard/clean/checkout branch are BANNED in the shared tree; use scripts/parity-ab.sh worktree; record named failing tests not counts (pkg-node gitignored).

walls.name: Portal punch depth
walls.rule: Punch writes gl_FragDepth so a depthFunc flip compares FAR and rejects everywhere; outdoor Z-wipe does not exist in retail (indoor-looking-out only); portalStencil arms a scaffold that empties layer 1.

walls.name: Per-texel relief displacement retired
walls.rule: 5-10x Nyquist gap, polarity backwards on Tudor; ?gfxSubdivLevel=5 crashes the renderer; raising subdiv is not a fix.

walls.name: Disposal is not the OOM
walls.rule: Orphaned textures 164 MB non-ratcheting; residency is the memory problem; context-loss recovery re-uploads from CPU so a released mirror needs a re-supply path.

walls.name: Entities/particles stay unpooled
walls.rule: Entities ~27 draws @12.7 us are not the cost; moving particles into pools measured harmful.

walls.name: Retail Wine oracle resolution
walls.rule: ~1 Hz c2s heartbeat cannot resolve animation timing; cast/stance retail captures add ~zero info (server-driven) — do not build a retail cast/stance driver.

walls.name: Cast/combat parity settled
walls.rule: Never auto-switch combat mode on cast (DEC-2); do not widen the 500 ms dedup window (R8); CAST_SPEED=2.0 is correct; combat-mode gate must stay fail-open (LastCombatMode window).

walls.name: UNIFIED_LOCO / O6 / netWorker refutations
walls.rule: B-1 integrator overshoot refuted; O6 was run-rate source mismatch (don't touch SIDESTEP constants); GameMessage dispatch never leaves main thread under netWorker.

walls.name: Bake worker fallback / renderOnDemand
walls.rule: LB-crossing stall is NOT bake-worker crash backoff (fallbacks 0); renderOnDemand=1 does NOT stall boot (stale ACE session did).

walls.name: Counter-naming artifacts
walls.rule: fullSwaps/pvwBuilds are ST5-only counters (structurally 0 off-arm); legacy full-tier upgrades count on singletonUpgrades.

walls.name: Record-level dedup / terrain bake
walls.rule: Record-level dedup measured 0.00 MB; terrain baking ~265x its record — both dead.

walls.name: Plain running never leaves the ground
walls.rule: Zero lift-offs on every synthetic and real Holtburg course at 12/18 m/s, 30-144 fps, seams, hitches to 1.5 s. 'Hops' are bounce relaunches or trunk-clamp pops, not terrain following.

walls.name: Hop measurement trap
walls.rule: A pop without an airborne frame is invisible to lift-off detectors; a 1 cm depth probe produced fake open-terrain pops. Use __diag.hop.

walls.name: Fence-rail climb is retail
walls.rule: 0.875 m rail climb at 0xA9B4 is step_up 0.6x1.5 (acclient.c:312794) — leave it.

walls.name: Slowdown refuted causes
walls.rule: Not the castTakesControl latch, not interpolation pull (leashEchoGate), not a slower server run rate (ACE omits 1.0, we run faster).

walls.name: Slow-run test aliasing
walls.rule: Every ~5th 33 ms harness frame runs ~3% short (quantum aliasing); compare mean speed, not single frames.

walls.name: Floating spawns are ACE, not decode
walls.rule: ACE Spawn_Scatter really sends creatures 10-67 m up; WebAC floats them too. Fix is client settle, not a parser.

walls.name: Retail ignores its own autonomous echo
walls.rule: CPhysics::SetObjectMovement never processes the local player's autonomous echo (acclient.c:311149); don't let it release sticky.

walls.name: Heading convention
walls.rule: Pose heading 0=West,90=North; wire/retail 0=North,90=East. pose = wire + 90 deg; convert only via holtburger_common::math.

walls.name: A portal is not its mesh or the ODF bit
walls.rule: Every portal is invisible quad 0x0100168B + light + script; 22 disguised Portal weenies carry the PORTAL bit. Key portal visuals on Setup.

walls.name: Lights live in the object frame
walls.rule: Retail LIGHTLIST::set_frame combines object frame + LightInfo offset; the key is never a part.

walls.name: Degrade bands are part GfxObjs
walls.rule: A degrade band must be posed by the Setup part frame (setup_part_frame), never drawn raw at the Setup origin.

walls.name: three.js clone traps
walls.rule: Material.clone drops onBeforeCompile but keeps userData flags (CSM lost); ShaderMaterial.clone makes new Texture on same Source (BC7 stuck t128); BufferGeometry.clone shares userData; value-copied uniforms freeze identity-bound feeds.

walls.name: Particle display calibration
walls.rule: Composer applies exposure 5 before tone map: unlit particles need alpha x1/exposure and additive xK/exposure (K 4 day, 2 night). A single K=2 left emissives 0.5x by day.

walls.name: Erosion thresholds perceptual energy
walls.rule: Threshold sqrt(linear), not linear texels, or small flame/smoke puffs erode to fragments.

walls.name: smokePuff texture is black
walls.rule: DAT texture 0x08000326 is rgb 0; no tint can recolour it.

walls.name: No per-bucket instanced attributes
walls.rule: Bucket geometry is a shared _instGeomCache clone; disposing per-bucket geometry kills shared buffers. Ride spare instance-matrix row instead.

walls.name: Keep quad bases det > 0
walls.rule: A reflected (det -1) stretch basis flips winding and front-face culling drops every quad; scale along velocity instead of rotating.

walls.name: GLSL pow of negative base
walls.rule: pow(negative, 2.0) is undefined in GLSL — square by hand.

walls.name: fp32 world coordinates
walls.rule: Absolute world positions past 32 km resolve ~3.9 mm in fp32 (Holtburg ~34.6 km): use camera-relative positions computed in float64 on CPU.

walls.name: Terrain sampler budget
walls.rule: ANGLE D3D11 on the 1070 has 16 fragment units; terrain uses 15. New terrain data must ride existing textures (e.g. uVertexTypes columns) or free slots by merging CSM cascades.

walls.name: Rivers are flat terraces
walls.rule: 99.6% of running water sits on flats; flow direction must come from topology (priority flood), not slope.

walls.name: Retail sorting radius is not a cull sphere
walls.rule: max(maxOffset, maxA*lifespan) ignores gravity; waterfall sheets travel 44-134 m vs 12-18 m sphere.

walls.name: Nanto waterfall emitter misidentification
walls.rule: 0x32000829/0x3200002F are a torch glow and wall-torch flame; Blue Ghost Falls use 0x32000031 + 0x3200000C.

walls.name: Look-pass declined/failed ideas
walls.rule: Far paint (owner OFF), Kuwahara filters (~2/255), fractal border perturbation (rectangular blocks), Wall Hook plaques (retail-faithful) — do not retry blind.

walls.name: Lifestone shaft declined
walls.rule: Owner rejected the light shaft; use crystal emanance (?lifestoneFx).

walls.name: slideCast + castTakesControl together
walls.rule: Running both on gives the stuck slide (deferred release keeps injected strafe). Browser pair: castTakesControl on, slideCast off.

walls.name: Cast harness must queue MaybeStopCompletely
walls.rule: SlideStep::CastRequest without the stop made fix-1 tests pass while production cleared held keys.

walls.name: remoteSpineHeading stale
walls.rule: Rust remote body heading is stale at rest; drawing TurnTo from it snapped vendors ~96 deg. Keep opt-in until RemoteMover adopts server heading.

walls.name: Legacy storm scan
walls.rule: The legacy storm scan reported a storm every day; retail weather bit is now default.

walls.name: Film scenery fades by geometry
walls.rule: Geometric attribution of CollisionHit to scenery is unreliable (boulder beside tree = false clear view); needs placement index.

walls.name: Bus selection payload
walls.rule: Bus CustomEvent payload is ev.detail; reading ev.guid/ev directly broke melee charges, sneak diag, combatFxBus, rynth selectionChanged.

walls.name: Laptop shows no tier-1/2 FX
walls.rule: Laptop probes to quality low, so a bare boot draws none of fxLights/Glow/Kids/Smoke/Distort/Motion/Shapes/Decals/Clamp/Showcase/Fields; perf/look claims need the 1070 at high/ultra.

walls.name: Look-pass fps numbers are live A/Bs
walls.rule: 1070 look-pass 'within noise' results were single live A/Bs, not multi-rep benches; Holtburg town (~33 fps, 938 draws) is the frame-time floor.

walls.name: CSM cost
walls.rule: With CSM on, any moving entity in range re-rendered all three cascades (~12 ms main thread); CSM is off by default on every preset.

walls.name: renderer.info undercounts under ANGLE
walls.rule: ANGLE D3D11 emulates WEBGL_multi_draw per range (5,838 ranges behind 1,921 calls); use __diag.render.batchedCalls/subDraws and GPU-process thread split.

walls.name: Log depth defeats early-Z
walls.rule: The log depth buffer writes gl_FragDepth in every program; June reversedZ 'no win' was a CPU-bound measurement.

walls.name: Kept-off flags with settled reasons
walls.rule: USE_ETHEREAL_RECHECK models wrong path; castFacing20 dormant; castVfxDedup only adds non-retail; sortCenter fixed -100 band defect; entityLights doubles setup lights; portalPass2 unfinished.

walls.name: ACE drops a swing requested mid-swing
walls.rule: Requesting the next melee swing while ACE is still in the killing swing is silently dropped (Player_Melee.cs); wait for AttackDone.
